description: Java entity class representing an order account product within the sales management system. Defines mapping to database table 'ORDER_ACCOUNT_PRODUCT' with fields for dates, status, and relationships to other entities.

classes.name: OrderAccountProduct
classes.description: Represents a product associated with an order account, including relevant dates, status, and relationships to other entities.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order account product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the order account product.

methods.name: getOrderAccount
methods.description: Returns the associated order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccount
methods.description: Sets the associated order account.

methods.name: getOrderProduct
methods.description: Returns the associated order product.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Sets the associated order product.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date of the order account product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the order account product, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date of the order account product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the order account product, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductEot
methods.description: Returns a clone of the 'end of term' date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductEot
methods.description: Sets the 'end of term' date, cloning the input.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductAccountedDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the accounted date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the accounted date, cloning the input.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductLastStatusDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the last status date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductLastStatusDate
methods.description: Sets the last status date, cloning the input.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductLastTransactionStatus
methods.description: Returns the last transaction status.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductLastTransactionStatus
methods.description: Sets the last transaction status.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductPaymentFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the payment frequency type.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductPaymentFrequencyType
methods.description: Sets the payment frequency type.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the order account product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the order account product.
